rules: Each existing unit test file exactly once; zero-test categories NOT_RUN; separate category unit results never substitute for engine rankings or real-world truth.

categories.label: Map data and road graph
categories.scope: OSM graph, import and provenance checks; no independently surveyed UK road law.

categories.label: Road legality and restrictions
categories.scope: Mapped one-way, access and turn restriction contract checks; legal truth provisional.

categories.label: GPS positioning and road matching
categories.scope: Map-derived position/heading/candidate tests; no independent real GNSS accuracy.

categories.label: GPS signal loss and recovery
categories.scope: Simulated invalid GPS, missed fixes and reacquisition; no phone/tunnel field proof.

categories.label: Route computation and validity
categories.scope: Actual local route search and frozen input validation tests.

categories.label: Route quality and preferences
categories.scope: Route length/time/cost and preference units, not independently optimal UK routes.

categories.label: Route calculation speed
categories.scope: Timing-worker test methodology and algorithm units; no comparable cross-engine latency ranking.

categories.label: Junction turns and maneuvers
categories.scope: Junction scorer and instruction contract tests; not road-truth verified.

categories.label: Roundabout exits and paths
categories.scope: Synthetic roundabout exit/instruction controls only.

categories.label: Lane counts and next-turn guidance
categories.scope: Actual UK lane arrows, combined turn/through and best-lane advice not executed.

categories.label: Route line and turn-point road adherence
categories.scope: Full route-line drift, roundabout arc clipping, wrong-side turn point untested.

categories.label: Wrong turns and rerouting
categories.scope: Rerouting controller state and wrong-turn policies; not full Android real drives.

categories.label: Navigation instructions and timing
categories.scope: No measured approach/at-turn/after-turn or adaptive spoken timing test.

categories.label: Traffic, closures and dynamic replanning
categories.scope: Live incident, closure and traffic response tests not executed.

categories.label: Road section speed limits and alerts
categories.scope: Speed-limit per-section, alert correctness and verified camera checks not executed.

categories.label: Correct arrival and approach side
categories.scope: Arrival state/controller units, not verified driveway/property approach.

categories.label: Offline routing, maps and updates
categories.scope: Host offline navigation package tests; Android downloads/updates not demonstrated.

categories.label: Voice, Bluetooth and music ducking
categories.scope: Android voice/Bluetooth music ducking not tested.

categories.label: Failure handling, integrity and safety gates
categories.scope: Evidence integrity and readiness gate tests, not full app resilience.

categories.label: Memory, CPU, energy and map size
categories.scope: Synthetic benchmark controls; no equivalent device CPU/RAM/battery measurements.

categories.label: Complete press-navigate driving
categories.scope: No end-to-end full UK map-replay with actual Android navigation.

categories.label: Android emulator and app integration
categories.scope: No Android emulator/device integration executed by this unit stage.

categories.label: Competitor adapters and comparison integrity
categories.scope: Adapter contract checks are not live external engine comparisons.
